name: Karate Frog
title: The Lily-Step Keeper
style: Spring kicks and close-range control

combat.cardStyle: Leaping kicks and spins

story: Karate Frog used to teach on stepping stones until the late-summer floods covered them. She moved her class to the giant lily pads and taught everyone to land lightly enough to leave the dew in place. The kids started keeping score by how many pads they could cross without getting wet. She still holds the record.
quote: Land softly. The next step is already waiting.

powers.name: Lily Vault
powers.effect: Spring forward into a double-foot kick, then land back in guard.
powers.counter: Move off the line while the Frog crouches.

powers.name: Tadpole Tornado
powers.effect: Spin to push nearby fighters away and deflect incoming pebbles.
powers.counter: Back out of the marked circle before the spin connects.

name: River Otter
title: The Three-Stone Ferrier
style: Lateral counters and ranged pressure

combat.cardStyle: Palm strikes and pebbles

story: River Otter marked the safe route home for the Tideharbor ferry when the river rose one spring. With the sandbars hidden, he skipped pebbles to show the ferrier where the current split. Now he teaches first-time boaters the route and carries three smooth stones from that day in his sash.
quote: A river always gives you another angle.

powers.name: Eddy Palm
powers.effect: Cut sideways and strike from the new angle with an open palm.
powers.counter: Turn with the Otter and wait for the palm.

powers.name: Pebble Barrage
powers.effect: Send three pebbles through separate lanes to pressure opponents toward the edge.
powers.counter: Step outside the spread, guard, or deflect with Tadpole Tornado.

name: Rooster Kickboxer
title: First Bell of Dawn
style: Aerial kicks and fast follow-ups

combat.cardStyle: Rising kicks and a dive

story: Rooster rings the first bell at Dawn Observatory. When the east steps froze, he carried the bell by jumping from the raised stones beside the path. The long climb became his favorite morning drill. On festival day he still arrives first to sweep the mat and welcomes anyone awake enough to spar.
quote: Every round starts with one sure step.

powers.name: Spur Lift
powers.effect: Step in with a rising kick that briefly lifts the opponent.
powers.counter: Give the planted foot room and move off the kick line.

powers.name: Feather Flurry
powers.effect: Vault into two quick bicycle kicks and finish with a diving third kick.
powers.counter: Step aside before the vault or guard the kicks you cannot avoid.

name: Sugar Glider
title: The Canopy Courier
style: Wing sweeps and wind control

combat.cardStyle: Side slips and gust control

story: Sugar Glider carries notes between the shrines above Skywalk Peaks. She learned to read the wind from chimes along the ridge and sewed their knot pattern into her sleeves. She tests new routes by dropping a ribbon into the air and following where it falls. At the dojo, those same turns help her land a sweep from an unexpected angle.
quote: Watch the ribbons. They’ll show you where to go.

powers.name: Canopy Slip
powers.effect: Slip sideways on the mat and sweep across the opponent’s guard line.
powers.counter: Turn with the Glider and keep space for the sweep.

powers.name: Gust Vortex
powers.effect: Glide forward and leave a marked funnel that first pulls foes in, then bursts outward.
powers.counter: Leave the circle early or face its center and guard.

name: Desert Scorpion
title: The Three Coals
style: Pincer sweeps and placement traps

combat.cardStyle: Pincer sweeps and traps

story: Desert Scorpion lays out the kiln floor before the potters arrive. She learned to mark the safe spots with three colored tiles and to move around the hot spots without spilling her tray. Her festival bout starts the same way: three bright markers, then a quick pincer sweep when her opponent steps into the open.
quote: Look where you’re going to put your feet.

powers.name: Tail Feint
powers.effect: Show the tail, slip sideways, and sweep from the new angle with a pincer.
powers.counter: Turn with Scorpion and keep space for the sweep.

powers.name: Cinder Snare
powers.effect: Place three glowing nodes. After the warning, the triangle roots unguarded fighters caught on the floor for 0.72 seconds.
powers.counter: Get outside the triangle, jump the trigger, or face its center and guard.

name: Pistol Shrimp
title: Breaker of the Still Pool
style: Quick snaps and wide knockback

combat.cardStyle: Claw rush and a water shockwave

story: Pistol Shrimp clears driftwood from Lantern Quay when the tide turns. One quick claw snap sends a ripple down the channel, and the dock crew follows it with their nets. At the dojo he paints the inside of his claw bright coral so an opponent can see exactly when it opens for the snap.
quote: Watch the water when the quay goes quiet.

powers.name: Claw Dash
powers.effect: Close the gap with a quick step and finish with a fitted claw snap.
powers.counter: Leave the path as Shrimp winds the large claw back.

powers.name: Cavitation Cannon
powers.effect: Release a ground shockwave that travels to the edge of the arena and pushes each fighter it hits outward once.
powers.counter: Face the center and guard, or jump as the wave reaches you.

name: Walrus Sumo
title: Keeper of the Tide Bell
style: Heavy palm strikes and a wide landing wave

combat.cardStyle: Heavy palms and a splash landing

story: Walrus Sumo rings the tide bell when the harbor ramps are safe. His students practice moving heavy rope coils across the wet boards without slipping. On festival days he takes the same broad stance into the ring and calls out the first round himself.
quote: Plant your feet before you make a splash.

powers.name: Harbor Palm
powers.effect: Drive a broad open-handed palm into range and push the opponent back.
powers.counter: Keep space outside the reach of his leading hand.

powers.name: Tidal Belly-Flop
powers.effect: Leap toward the marked circle, land belly-first, and send a water pulse outward.
powers.counter: Leave the circle before Walrus lands, or face the landing spot and guard.

name: Snapping Tortoise
title: The Breakwater Builder
style: Heavy checks and rebounding shell rolls

combat.cardStyle: Shoulder checks and a bouncing roll

story: Snapping Tortoise rebuilt the old breakwater one clay block at a time. He scratched an angle on each corner so the younger builders could see where the waves would rebound. Now he teaches that same lesson in the ring, where a second pass can come from a very different direction.
quote: Watch the wall. Then watch where I go next.

powers.name: Shell Check
powers.effect: Turn behind the armored shoulder and step into a short, heavy strike.
powers.counter: Step around the lead shoulder while Tortoise turns.

powers.name: Fortress Ricochet
powers.effect: Tuck into the shell and roll for up to four seconds, rebounding off the arena edges.
powers.counter: Watch the launch line, move out of each pass, or parry to stop the roll.

name: Armadillo Striker
title: The Kiln Cart Courier
style: Armored checks and a straight-line roll

combat.cardStyle: Armored checks and a guard-breaking roll

story: Armadillo hauls kiln supplies up the Glaze Terrace switchbacks. When a cart wheel cracked on the last turn, he rolled a loose barrel out of the lane before it reached the stair. He now chalks the same straight line on the mat to teach where to stand when something heavy is moving.
quote: Once I tuck, I follow the line.

powers.name: Plate Check
powers.effect: Drive an armored forearm across close range for 21 damage.
powers.counter: Back out of forearm range as Armadillo sets his leading foot.

powers.name: Meteor Roll
powers.effect: Tuck and roll along the marked line. The shell knocks targets back, deals 30 base damage and breaks an ordinary guard.
powers.counter: Leave the line or time a parry to stop the roll.

name: Komodo Dragon
title: Keeper of the Glaze Kilns
style: Sweeping tail strikes and ember breath

combat.cardStyle: Tail sweeps and a moving ember cone

story: Komodo tends the glaze kilns when the yard goes quiet. He listens for the draft and shifts the shutters until the heat spreads evenly through the chamber. In sparring he sweeps his breath in that same measured rhythm, watching his opponent’s feet between turns.
quote: A steady breath reaches farther.

powers.name: Tail Rake
powers.effect: Pivot and sweep across close range with the tail for 21 damage.
powers.counter: Step out of the sweep as Komodo turns his shoulder.

powers.name: Volcanic Breath
powers.effect: Sweep an ember cone across the marked arc. It pushes each target once for 22 damage. An unguarded hit adds two 3-damage burn ticks.
powers.counter: Leave the marked arc or face Komodo and guard against the sweep.

name: Electric Owl
title: Mistline Signal Keeper
style: Quick wing strikes and a lightning dive

combat.cardStyle: Close wing sweeps and a lightning landing

story: Electric Owl watches the crossing lanterns when fog covers the lower trails. A storm once put out every light on the rope bridge. Owl carried the signal rope across and rang the far bell until every traveler reached shelter. In the dojo, Owl practices the same quick descent and precise landing.
quote: Pick your landing before you take flight.

powers.name: Wing Sweep
powers.effect: Sweep a leading wing across close range for 18 damage.
powers.counter: Back out of the sweep or time a parry.

powers.name: Thunder Dive
powers.effect: Blink forward and dive into the marked landing. A clean hit shocks the opponent for 1.2 seconds. Bosses resist shock during their committed attacks.
powers.counter: Step outside the landing circle or defend as Owl touches down.

name: Bighorn Ram
title: The Switchback Warden
style: Braced horn checks and a charging burst

combat.cardStyle: Braced horn checks and a distance-powered burst

story: Bighorn knows the sound of every wind chime on the ridge. When loose stones threaten the switchbacks, Ram closes the trail and braces the guide posts until the road crew arrives. His sparring charge starts with the same planted breath he takes before moving a heavy stone.
quote: Measure the path. Then move.

powers.name: Horn Check
powers.effect: Plant the lead hoof and drive into close range for 20 damage.
powers.counter: Step to the side as Ram lowers his head.

powers.name: Static Charge
powers.effect: Rush down the marked lane and release a circular burst. The farther Ram actually travels, the wider the burst.
powers.counter: Leave the lane and the marked stopping point before Ram braces.

name: Honey Badger
title: Cedar Foothill Pathkeeper
style: Close hook strikes and relentless swipes

combat.cardStyle: Low hooks and four broad swipes

story: Honey Badger clears storm debris from the foothill paths before the first market carts set out. The trail crew knows where Badger has worked by the small cairns beside each cleared turn. Badger spars in the same steady rhythm, staying planted when challenged.
quote: One stone at a time.

powers.name: Burrow Hook
powers.effect: Dip low and sweep a short hook for 20 damage.
powers.counter: Step back or defend as Badger rises.

powers.name: Unstoppable Frenzy
powers.effect: Swing four times into a wide cone. For five seconds knockback and stun cannot interrupt Badger, who still takes damage.
powers.counter: Clear the cone or defend against each swipe.

name: Emerald Saber-Tooth
title: Jade Crossing Scout
style: Precise rakes and a sudden rooted landing

combat.cardStyle: Precise rakes and a pounce that roots the floor

story: Emerald maps the stone markers along Jade Crossing so the courier crews can find their way after sunset. The polished shoulder plates carry the small marks of each district visited. At the dojo Emerald watches for a safe landing before committing to a pounce.
quote: I know where I’ll land.

powers.name: Jade Rake
powers.effect: Step into a diagonal swipe for 21 damage.
powers.counter: Leave the sweep or meet it with a parry.

powers.name: Apex Pounce
powers.effect: Blink toward the nearest available foe. The landing deals 26 damage and leaves a mark that briefly roots grounded opponents.
powers.counter: Leave the marked landing or defend on impact.

name: Great White Shark
title: Breakwater Guide
style: Measured hooks and a sudden underwater approach

combat.cardStyle: Close hooks and a marked underwater eruption

story: Shark guides the harbor tenders around the submerged beams of the old galleon. The crew follows the fin just above the water to find the channel. In the ring, Shark uses the same patience to choose where to surface.
quote: Watch the ripples.

powers.name: Reef Hook
powers.effect: Step into a short hook for 21 damage.
powers.counter: Step back or defend before the wrap connects.

powers.name: Jaws of the Deep
powers.effect: Dive out of reach for a moment, then erupt at the marked spot for 28 damage.
powers.counter: Leave the surface marker or defend as Shark rises.

name: Abyssal Kraken
title: Tidecall Warden
style: Heavy wraps and four timed inward slams

combat.cardStyle: Heavy strikes and four marked tentacle lanes

story: The Tidecall Warden teaches dock apprentices to haul nets in rhythm. In the dojo this Kraken summons four water shapes in the same steady cadence. Harbor stories tell of an ancient Kraken that guards the depths below the docks.
quote: Four beats. Find your opening.

powers.name: Tide Grip
powers.effect: Land a close-range tentacle strike for 20 damage.
powers.counter: Step outside the reach of the lead arm.

powers.name: Tentacle Cataclysm
powers.effect: Summon four telegraphed tentacles that slam inward, each for 9 damage.
powers.counter: Move between the marked lanes or guard each slam.

name: Magma Grizzly Bear
title: Cinder Kiln Keeper
style: Heavy short-range strikes and a line of erupting pillars

combat.cardStyle: Broad backhands and four marked eruptions

story: Grizzly helps fire the ceramic tiles used on the Cinder Terraces roofs. Before the kilns are opened, the crew waits for the keeper to tap each vent. That measured rhythm carries into the ring, where every eruption follows its own warning.
quote: Watch the floor.

powers.name: Basalt Backhand
powers.effect: Step into a heavy, short-range backhand for 22 damage.
powers.counter: Step back or defend as the lead arm swings.

powers.name: Eruption Slam
powers.effect: Raise four marked pillars in a line for 12 damage per eruption. Each opponent can be hit at most twice.
powers.counter: Step out of the line or guard at the eruption.

name: Obsidian Hellhound
title: Cinder Lift Runner
style: A quick lunge and two spectral charges across the ring

combat.cardStyle: Fast lunges and two sweeping spectral charges

story: Hellhound ferries kiln tools between the steam lifts before the morning bell. The crews time their handoffs by the glow of the runner’s obsidian wraps. In the ring, two spectral companions repeat the same dash on a second beat.
quote: Wait for the second beat.

powers.name: Cinder Lunge
powers.effect: Lunge forward for a 22-damage strike.
powers.counter: Step to the side or defend when the lunge reaches you.

powers.name: Hellfire Stampede
powers.effect: Send two spectral clones across the playable width of the ring. Each deals 17 damage on contact.
powers.counter: Leave the marked lane or defend as each clone passes.

name: Golden Eagle
title: Cloudstep Wayfinder
style: Quick wing strikes and a carrying dive

combat.cardStyle: Quick wing strikes and a carrying dive

story: Golden Eagle scouts the Cloudstep Pass when cloud hides the next bridge. The temple guides hang a gold ribbon along each safe route Eagle finds. In the ring, Eagle reads the open space before committing to a dive.
quote: Leave yourself room to land.

powers.name: Gale Rake
powers.effect: Sweep a fitted wing strike for 20 damage.
powers.counter: Step outside the wing arc or guard the swing.

powers.name: Talon Drop
powers.effect: Catch an opponent, carry them briefly and drop them for 28 damage.
powers.counter: Clear the approach or defend before the grab.

name: Celestial Storm Dragon
title: Wind Court Stormkeeper
style: Measured claw strikes and a steerable lightning beam

combat.cardStyle: Heavy claws and a steerable storm beam

story: Dragon keeps the Wind Court weather chimes and closes the high paths when storm clouds gather. The temple apprentices learn to read the chime rhythm before they go out. In the ring, a marked strike follows the beam's last sound.
quote: Watch where the light lands.

powers.name: Storm Claw
powers.effect: Step into a measured claw strike for 21 damage.
powers.counter: Step back or defend as the claw sweeps forward.

powers.name: Tempest Roar
powers.effect: Use movement controls to steer five 6-damage beam pulses left or right. A separate marked thunder strike deals 10 damage.
powers.counter: Leave the beam lane and the marked thunder circle.
